scope: robolab PickGlassesTask at the pinned revision; generated per predicate family (picked_up); seed-0 witness pending. Semantic projection of the official termination, not physical qualification.

predicate_and_helpers.basis: Read PickGlassesTask terminations: success = object_picked_up(object='glasses', surface='table', distance=0.05), and the helpers in conditionals.py and predicate_logic.py; RobolabEnv records success as the TerminationManager's terminated flag, the OR of every non-timeout term.

reset_and_randomization.basis: Scene workdesk.usda: glasses among 15 contact objects. The env's only event is reset_scene_to_default and the task adds none, so every seed resets to the same authored layout; a seed varies physics only.

assets_and_frames.basis: Gripper contact (any finger body) and every box corner above the table's top face by the lift margin, with the centroid over the table's footprint.

success_timing.basis: DoneTerm success is evaluated every control step; RobolabEnv freezes the env at the first true step (a termination within its first two steps is reset as a physics artifact) and the ORA session latches it.

public_observability.basis: At reset every named object (1) projects into the over-shoulder or wrist camera with a depth reading that does not hide it (witness sha256 6a599c33e995).

success_witness.basis: Witness (seed 0, sha256 6a599c33e995): held_and_lifted -> True; each case from a fresh reset, objects placed by direct state edits with the robot held.

counterexamples.basis: Witness (seed 0, sha256 6a599c33e995): reset_state -> False; lifted_not_held -> False.

no_expert_strategy.basis: Clauses state end conditions only; no approach, grasp, route or motion advice.

privacy.basis: No coordinates, thresholds, fixture or object identifiers, joint values or predicate names enter the public text; numeric limits stay in this private record.

conditions.source_basis: success = object_picked_up(object='glasses', surface='table', distance=0.05): object_grabbed (gripper contact) and object_above(table, z_margin=distance): every box corner above the table's top face by the margin, centroid over its footprint.
conditions.interpretation: Held and lifted clear of the table.
Contact force bar and lift margin withheld.

public_clauses: The eyeglasses must be held in the gripper and lifted so that all of them are clear above the table top, still over the table.
The task completes while they are held: once set down or dropped, they do not count.

witness_plan.note: each case starts from a fresh reset of seed 0; the robot holds its reset pose with the gripper open unless a case grasps; success is any official result over the case's ticks
